newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank BOS sets issue price at PLN 29.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank BOS sets issue price at PLN 29.

text.p: Polish Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA (BOS), whose 1.2 million share public offering starts on Monday, set its issue price at 29 zlotys per share, PAP news agency said on Saturday.
BOS, which is seeking a main-market listing in January 1997, had given up underwriting the issue because of the large demand at the book-building stage.
Large investors can register for at least 25,000 shares in the large-investor tranche of 800,000 shares, while 400,000 shares are being offered in the small-investor tranche.
BOS, which specialises in funding environmental protection projects, had a net profit of 31.8 million zlotys in 1995 on 210.6 million zlotys in interest and other related revenues.
The bank's main shareholders are the National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management, with 44.4 percent, the State Treasury, with 7.8 percent, and Ciech SA with 5.8 percent.
